hook: Your satellite map shows ships stuck in a desert.
title: Ships Stranded In A Desert Where A Sea Was
description:
The Aral Sea in Central Asia, between Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan, was once a huge lake. Water from its rivers was diverted for farming and the lake shrank away. Rusting ships still sit on the dry ground near Moynaq.

#Shorts #AralSea #Geography
comment_prompt: Could this happen elsewhere? Yes or no
